task.goal: In Simple Calendar Pro, delete all events scheduled for this Thursday.
task.final_summary: I deleted both events scheduled for this Thursday, October 19: "Call with Marketing" (12:00 to 13:00) and "Meeting with HR" (23:00 to midnight into October 20). The Thursday, October 19 day view now shows no events.

steps.note: Load simple-calendar skill, then observe screen
Back to month view, then tap Thursday cell in week of Oct 19
Tap Oct 19 cell (row 4, Thursday column) and read day view header
Open the first Oct 19 event to delete it
Tap Delete on Call with Marketing, confirm dialog
Confirm deletion, then delete Meeting with HR
Open Meeting with HR and delete it
Tap Delete on Meeting with HR, then Yes
Confirm deletion and verify Oct 19 has no events
Confirm Oct 19 day list is empty, then done
Task complete; both Oct 19 events deleted and day view empty
